INSERT INTO psk_stats_build_short_80k SELECT toString(number), number FROM numbers_mt(80000) SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO psk_stats_build_short_200k SELECT toString(number), number FROM numbers_mt(200000) SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO psk_stats_build_64_8k SELECT substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(number)), 2), 1, 64), number FROM numbers_mt(8000) SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO psk_stats_build_64_60k SELECT substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(number)), 2), 1, 64), number FROM numbers_mt(60000) SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1

INSERT INTO psk_stats_probe_short SELECT toString(id_10k), toString(id_80k), toString(id_200k) FROM ( SELECT cityHash64(number) % 2 = 0 AS hit, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 10000, 10000 + number)) AS id_10k, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 80000, 80000 + number)) AS id_80k, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 200000, 200000 + number)) AS id_200k FROM numbers_mt(40000000) )

INSERT INTO psk_stats_probe_64 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_8k_50)), 2), 1, 64), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_60k_0)), 2), 1, 64), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_60k_50)), 2), 1, 64), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_60k_100)), 2), 1, 64), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_200k_50)), 2), 1, 64), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_200k_0)), 2), 1, 64) FROM ( SELECT cityHash64(number) % 2 = 0 AS hit, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 8000, 8000 + number)) AS id_8k_50, toUInt64(60000 + number) AS id_60k_0, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 60000, 60000 + number)) AS id_60k_50, toUInt64(intHash64(number + 1) % 60000) AS id_60k_100, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 200000, 200000 + number)) AS id_200k_50, toUInt64(200000 + number) AS id_200k_0 FROM numbers_mt(10000000) )

INSERT INTO psk_stats_probe_256 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_30k_0)), 8), 1, 256), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_30k_50)), 8), 1, 256), substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id_30k_100)), 8), 1, 256) FROM ( SELECT cityHash64(number) % 2 = 0 AS hit, toUInt64(30000 + number) AS id_30k_0, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 30000, 30000 + number)) AS id_30k_50, toUInt64(intHash64(number + 1) % 30000) AS id_30k_100 FROM numbers_mt(2500000) )
